attBesluta.text: Lovely product. I have come to loving Vevor products. They have good built, high quality and match the descriptions. I will continue to buy more products from Vevor.

Bought 3 mats to use in garage due to the wet weather in Pacific Northwest. I give this product 5 stars because of functionality and price. However my wife is sensitive to the off gassing from the product, similar experience with outdoor furniture. Left mats outside for a couple of weeks before my wife could tolerate in enclosed garage.

Strong and very well made tortilla press and roti maker. Presses dough evenly. Spare nuts and washers are also included. I've seasoned my roti maker even as it was preseasoned, just as any other cast iron from time to time to make it extra nonstick even at lower temperatures. The removable silicone handle slips on and off easily, which allows it to cool when roti maker is used for extended period of time on high heat.
